disclosures.text: Protection apparatus for machine tools machining wood or similar materials
Protects against blunt instruments ejected from an operating unit
Barrier means define a machining area of the operating unit
Barrier means separate the operating unit from an operator
A supporting structure supports the barrier means
Supporting structure is positionable near the machine tool
Supporting structure comprises guide means
Guide means slidably support the barrier means
Baffle means overhang a machining plane and are movable relative to the operating unit
Slidable panel means cooperate with baffle means to define a machining area
Connecting means connect baffle means to panel means
Panel means are moved by the baffle means
Protection apparatus with barrier means defining a machining area, a supporting structure for the barrier means, and guide means for slidably supporting the barrier means

Protection apparatus with baffle means overhanging a machining plane and movable relative to an operating unit, slidable panel means cooperating with the baffle means, and connecting means for moving the panel means via the baffle means
Supporting structure extends substantially parallel to an advance direction of the operating unit
Supporting structure has a portal shape
Guide means comprise first guide means for slidably supporting door means
Door means enable operator access to the machining area
First guide means positioned on a first side of the supporting structure
First guide means extends substantially parallel to the advance direction
First guide means extends along a further direction perpendicular to the advance direction
First guide means extends along an arc path external to the advance direction
First guide means comprises a first guide and a second guide
First and second guides slidably support a first door element and a second door element
First and second guides are fixed to opposite end zones of the supporting structure
First guide means comprises a further first guide and a further second guide
Further first and second guides cooperate with the first and second guides
Further first and second guides slidably support the first and second door elements
Further first and second guides are fixed to an intermediate zone of the supporting structure
First and second door elements extend along a curved surface
Guide means comprise second guide means for slidably supporting first and second barrier elements
First and second barrier elements are positioned on opposite sides of the operating unit
First and second barrier elements cooperate with first and second door elements
First and second barrier elements define a first and second machining space
Second guide means extends substantially parallel to the advance direction
Second guide means is fixed to a second side of the supporting structure
First and second barrier elements each comprise a crosspiece element
Crosspiece element overhangs a machining plane of the operating unit
First and second barrier elements each comprise an upright element
Upright element is fixed to the crosspiece element
Upright element is positioned to the side of the machining plane
Screen means mounted in crosspiece element
Screen means movable substantially parallel to the further direction relative to the crosspiece element
First connecting means connect first and second barrier elements to a carriage
Carriage is movable along the advance direction and supports the operating unit
First and second barrier elements are moved by the carriage
First motor and second motor for moving first and second barrier elements
Second connecting means connect first and second barrier elements to first and second door elements
First and second door elements are moved by first and second barrier elements
Third motor means and fourth motor means for moving first and second door elements
Door elements move between a first position enabling operator access
Door elements move to a second position preventing operator access
Connecting means comprise first and second connecting means
First connecting means connects a first baffle to a first panel
Second connecting means connects a second baffle to a second panel
First and second panels are moved by first and second baffles
Panels move between a first configuration where they are substantially overlapped
Panels move to a second configuration where they are substantially side by side
Panel means comprises a plurality of panels
Panels are interposed between and connected to first and second panels
Panel means is slidably supported by guide means
Guide means extend along an advance direction of the operating unit
Guide means supported by a supporting structure
First and second baffles are positioned on opposite sides of the operating unit
Connecting elements connect first and second baffles to a carriage
First and second baffles are moved by the carriage along the advance direction
First motor means and second motor means for moving first and second baffles
First and second baffles substantially have the shape of an upturned 'L'
First and second baffles substantially have a portal shape
First and second baffles comprise a crosspiece element overhanging the machining plane
Movable screen means mounted on the crosspiece element
Screen means movable substantially perpendicularly to the advance direction
First and second baffles are slidably supported by further guide means
Further guide means extend substantially parallel to the advance direction
Further guide means is obtained on the supporting structure
